run.trigger: Operations asked the agent to work this case

steps.summary: Toyota Corolla for Vandellora Biler, Hamburg → Odense. Driver Carl Birkelane (assigned).
6 recent messages. Latest from Support desk: “Thanks for updating us. The assignment remains active while we prepare a backup and wait for your definite answer.”
1 open alert (Review illness risk for CD-420449; source is a conversation, not a verified outcome.), no incidents, 1 open task.
3 bookings; 3 quote or capacity checks (not bookings).

input.purpose: Bahn calling about CD-420449: your train to Copenhagen leaves in about 85 minutes and we need a definite answer on whether you can drive.
questions: Are you safe and how are you feeling right now?
Will you be fit to collect the car in Hamburg tomorrow and drive it to Odense, yes or no?
Will you take the booked train from Aalborg today?
If not yes now, when exactly can you give a final answer?

steps.summary: Simulated call Carl Birkelane. I'm safe at home, but I'm still unwell and not feeling much better than yesterday. I can't give you a yes right now; I'm still unsure whether I'll be well enough to drive CD-420449 safely.

input.text: The driver says they are safe at home but still unwell, cannot confirm being fit to drive, and will not take today's train unless clearly better within the hour. They promise a final yes or no by 12:45; no yes by then means treat it as a no and reassign.
The driver's travel is booked: train Aalborg to Copenhagen 21 Oct 13:25–17:45, flight Copenhagen to Hamburg 19:45–21:00, hotel in Hamburg tonight. Boarding is not confirmed.

Pickup in Hamburg is 22 Oct 11:00–14:00. The customer's delivery promise in Odense is 23 Oct 12:00–17:00. The next quoted flight, 22 Oct 09:00, misses the pickup slot (quote from 26 h ago), so a backup driver has to be in Hamburg tonight or be closer.
Both pickup and delivery contacts (Daniel and Eva Hollowmere) are unconfirmed and access needs checking (residential garage at pickup, named receiver at delivery). This needs doing whoever drives.

input.title: Get a backup driver ready to take over at 12:45 if Carl Birkelane doesn't say yes
input.rationale: The driver is still unwell and will give a final answer by 12:45. They asked us to treat no answer as a no. A backup has to reach Hamburg tonight to make the 22 Oct 11:00–14:00 pickup, and the backup prep that was already approved hasn't been done yet.

changes.label: Backup driver
changes.after: Backup driver lined up and on standby for 22 Oct pickup in Hamburg

changes.label: Assignment
changes.after: Unchanged until 12:45; reassign only if no yes by then

changes.label: Carl's travel (train 13:25, flight 19:45, Hamburg hotel)
changes.after: Unchanged; decide cancel or transfer only after 12:45

draft_message.body: CD-420449 Hamburg to Odense. Carl Birkelane is still ill. Final yes/no by 12:45; no yes means no. Please line up a backup now who can reach Hamburg tonight for pickup 22 Oct 11:00–14:00 (delivery promise 23 Oct 12:00–17:00 Odense). Don't cancel Carl or his train/flight/hotel before 12:45, so nothing gets double-booked. Pickup and delivery contacts are still unconfirmed.

input.what_happens_next: A person lines up a backup driver now. Carl stays assigned and his travel stays as booked until 12:45.
input.what_happens_after: The backup is on standby. At 12:45 ops either keeps Carl or reassigns the job and sorts out the travel.
